target_statement: Determine all low-degree extension sources for the two complete repeated-denominator types D=x^3 y and D=x^2 y^2, outside their already proved nondegenerate-quadric and pullback complements.
implication_to_classification: These are whole log-component boundary strata obtained by the closed quartic integrating-factor incidence and rational partial fractions. Empty support or a universal primitive evaluation rank<=3 proves G non-dominance on each whole stratum.
coefficient_ring: QQ; one transverse rank1 quadric uses QQ(u), retaining every exceptional root
hypotheses: Nonzero magnetic coefficient normalized to one. q restriction to ker(x,y) has rank<=1 and mixed rank is nonzero; all normalizations are checked separately.
inverted_elements: all explicit saved pivot minors, with every zero handled in the same finite run
complements: zero magnetic coefficient is R22 or actual L112
nondegenerate q restriction has a uniform empty-extension proof
zero mixed rank is the proved full pullback stratum
remaining D=x^2 yz and D=x^2 q are separate
success_certificate: Full QQ(u) coefficient matrices, exact kernel and translation minor, constant-source inverse, and every remaining positive-degree Pfaffian coefficient.
independent_check: Independent symbolic coefficient reconstruction and geometric review of the complete five-quadric normal forms and each exceptional residue.
negative_result_next_step: Keep unresolved exceptional residues and equations. If symbolic elimination exceeds the finite bound, switch to the hand classification of closed linear one-forms rather than another point or larger GB.
